title: Proteomics journals carried 51% of dataset-linked papers in 2013 and 10% in 2025
sub:
Journal (Europe PMC, joined by PMID) of the paper linked to PRIDE datasets: 22,475 papers published 2013–2025 (525 without a
journal, mostly preprints, excluded). Ranked by linked datasets; sparklines = share of each year’s papers (paper grain). Proteomics
journals = title contains “proteom” (18 titles). Bands: 95% bootstrap over contributor groups.
